أتخلخل (form IIq)
# أَتَخَلْخَلُ (ʔataḵalḵalu) /ʔa.ta.xal.xa.lu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَخَلْخَلَ (taḵalḵala)
# أَتَخَلْخَلَ (ʔataḵalḵala) /ʔa.ta.xal.xa.la/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَخَلْخَلَ (taḵalḵala)
# أَتَخَلْخَلْ (ʔataḵalḵal) /ʔa.ta.xal.xal/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَخَلْخَلَ (taḵalḵala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
